WITH wait_times AS (
    SELECT
        pickup_zone_id,
        AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (accepted_time - requested_time)) / 60) AS avg_wait_minutes
    FROM (
        SELECT
            t1.trip_id,
            t1.requested_time,
            t2.requested_time AS accepted_time,
            t1.pickup_zone_id
        FROM trips t1
        JOIN trips t2 ON t1.trip_id = t2.trip_id
        WHERE t1.trip_state = 'requested'
          AND t2.trip_state = 'accepted'
          AND t1.pickup_zone_id IN (48, 161)
    ) sub
    GROUP BY pickup_zone_id
)
SELECT
    (MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_zone_id = 48 THEN avg_wait_minutes END) - MAX(CASE WHEN pickup_zone_id = 161 THEN avg_wait_minutes END)) AS difference
FROM wait_times;
